title: 美国企业转向中国AI服务降本，市场承压
speaker: Mike Shepherd

segments.en: The companies here in the US that are trying to buy these services are starting to look at the bottom line and thinking, hey, all this AI that we're telling our employees to use, it's starting to cost us.
segments.zh: 美国购买这些服务的公司开始关注成本：我们让员工使用的AI开始花钱了。

segments.en: That is again another factor in this and it is causing this big down draft across the markets here. We compare these models, we compare the kind of technological advancements.
segments.zh: 这是另一个因素，导致市场大幅下行。我们比较这些模型和技术进步。
